name: Mount Bellig
title: Mount Bellig
summary: One of the pillar mesas of the Mount Alphus Range: a flat 224 m summit plateau about 150 x 160 m with sheer 110 m cliffs to the west and north-west. The summit carries only the Bellig Top portal (arrival from Bellig Tower) and the North Gemm portal at its south rim; the plains below are at about 110 m.

landmarks.name: Bellig Top portal
landmarks.note: Portal swirl (arrival from Bellig Tower) on the summit plateau.

landmarks.name: North Gemm portal
landmarks.note: On the south rim of the plateau.

landmarks.name: Mount Bellig summit plateau
landmarks.note: Flat 224 m mesa top, cliffs to about 110 m on the west and north-west.

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down from 47 m over the west cliff of Mount Bellig toward the Bellig Top portal, ending 15 m above the plateau rim and 32 m out; stay over the open drop, 40 m clear of both portals.
shots.notes: Signature view of the pillar mesa: the lens starts 58 m south-west of the Bellig Top portal and 47 m above the 224 m plateau, hanging over the 110 m west cliff, and corkscrews clockwise (0.13 turn) down to 32 m / 15 m while the gimbal holds the portal swirl centred, so the rock rim and the plains 110 m below slide under the frame. Afternoon sun (0.61, south-west) is behind the lens and lights the mesa top; Mount Alphus's pillar stands in the NE background.
